name: shepherd-dev
description: Supervised AI development via Shepherd (arXiv 2605.10913): sandboxed workers, deterministic test gate, skeptical reviewer, human-only settlement. Ships the shepherd-dev usage skill and the /shepherd-dev:run, run2, settle, settle-par, init, optimize commands.

interface.shortDescription: Supervised AI development: sandboxed workers + test gate + human-only settlement

skillInstructions: Adaptação Kimi Code: a skill cita ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}; neste ambiente o diretório do plugin é ~/.kimi-code/plugins/managed/shepherd-dev (a variável KIMI_PLUGIN_ROOT também aponta para lá em hooks). O CLI shepherd-dev normalmente já está instalado (uv tool install git+https://github.com/andrefogelman/shepherd.git); rode o bootstrap scripts/bootstrap.sh apenas se `command -v shepherd-dev` falhar.
